notes.title: Our newest game is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27505172/dc36d5af6c899df7d83d07360d16cf0a14efec8b.jpg[/img]

At long last, our newest game is now available! [b]Neo Harbor Rescue Squad[/b] brings fresh paramedic action and lets you save lives as a rookie paramedic today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/

As we celebrate launch, here are a few key things you'll want to know about the game:

[h3]1) It targets 4K/60fps on suitable hardware[/h3]
Yes, it's our first 4K game! We wanted the bright, colourful artwork and animation to really shine, so on capable systems (see the requirements on the main store page) the game can run up to native 4K resolution. Of course, in the Options menu, you can choose a variety of resolutions in both 16:9 and 16:10 ratios.

[h3]2) It's fully localized in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese[/h3]
Given that vibrant Neo Harbor City is inspired by co-designer Nancy's home town of Hong Kong, we wanted to make the game accessible to our Chinese-speaking friends and family. The localization team managed to even work in some language-specific puns!

[h3]3) It was designed with Steam Deck in mind[/h3]
Neo Harbor Rescue Squad runs at native 1280x800 resolution on Steam Deck and is fully controller-driven there, so if you have one, be sure to give it a go! We also are fans of Valve's portable system, so we wanted to make sure it was ready on day one.

Thanks for all your support so far. If you like the game, [b]please leave a review![/b] And if you have any issues, feel free to report them in the game's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2342780/discussions/0/?snr=1_5_9_]Tech Help discussion category[/url].

See you in the field!
- Ben & Nancy

notes.title: Our new game launches November 12!
notes.content:
Hello, out there!

As we've mentioned before, we've been cooking something a little different for our fourth game — [b]Neo Harbor Rescue Squad[/b] is an arcade-style game about saving lives as a rookie paramedic that uses fast-paced minigames and a battle-like triage system to simulate saving lives in the field.

It's obviously a lot more colourful and decidedly uh, less [i]horrific[/i], than something like Home, but the BancyCo approach still shines through: it's got some mystery, great characters, an innovative UI, and a story very personal to us, the developers.

And this labour of love [b]finally launches on November 12![/b] (Of course, you can still play the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/]free demo[/url] right now).

[b]Watch the new gameplay trailer:[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AKADGZyXbyk&ab_channel=BancyCo

We hope you'll give it a shot on launch day (for a 10% launch discount, BTW!) and keep an eye out for the Easter eggs we've hidden in the game...

Thanks as always for your support!
Ben & Nancy

notes.title: Being HOME ALONE WITH YOU is WORSE THAN DEATH!
notes.content:
As we celebrate the upcoming launch of our fourth game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/]Neo Harbor Rescue Squad[/url], we wanted to collect our first three titles for new and existing players. This bundle is a complete-the-set triple-pack, so if you've not played all of our previous titles, now is a great time to do so at a discounted price.


[h1]The games in this bundle[/h1]

[h2]😱 HOME - A UNIQUE HORROR ADVENTURE[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/215670/Home/

Awakened by an oncoming storm, you open your eyes to discover yourself in a strange, dark room – tucked away in a house that’s not yours. As you play the game, it changes – subtly, almost imperceptibly – to reflect your perspective. It's a horror game unlike any other, and as you'll discover, its truths are entirely subjective.

[h2]🚀 ALONE WITH YOU[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/564940/Alone_With_You/

Can love bloom on a doomed space colony? Alone With You is the tragic sci-fi follow-up to indie horror hit Home, in which you discover the fate of your crumbling installation with the help of a very emotive AI companion and four fully-realized holograms. Providing a rich story that adapts to your choices, Alone With You is the Space Quest-meets-OK Cupid adventure game you never knew you wanted – until now!

[h2]💀 WORSE THAN DEATH[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1029100/Worse_Than_Death/

Run for your life, hide in the shadows, and use your wits to avoid shadowy creatures and uncover the terrible truths of your wretched home town. Solve devious puzzles to reveal the emotionally-charged story of Holly and her friends that will have you hooked until the very end!

Horror, sci-fi, pixel art, and deep storytelling — complete your collection today!

notes.title: Neo Harbr Rescue Squad demo is available NOW!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/

[b]FINALLY[/b] we can show you what we’ve been working on for these last few years! It took a bit longer than we planned, based on our usual game release schedule, but now you can see what we've been cooking!

We would love, love, LOVE for you to give the demo a try. It'll show you about 30 minutes of what the game has to offer — the frantic action, the upbeat humour, and the loveable cast of characters we've created for you. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/][b]> Download it from the game's main page[/b][/url]

[h2]Some notes about the demo:[/h2]
[list]
[*]A DualSense, DualShock, or Xbox controller is recommended (there's some weirdness with Switch Pro controllers right now that will be fixed)
[*]The demo can be played in up to native 4K!
[*]There may be some weirdness with windowed mode right now; we'll fix that too
[*]The demo lets you fail treatment scenes with no penalty; we just want you to have fun; you can stress out in the full game
[/list]

[h2]We made a wholesome game!?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27505172/7ac4b21d936e8bcb70ed4afc291616b5aa6d9842.png[/img]

We're super excited that Neo Harbor Rescue Squad joins the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/url]. 🎉

For those who’ve played our previous games, you’ll notice a change in tone, and there’s a reason for that.
This game was conceived during the height of the pandemic. Initially, we were going to channel that into a dark mystery, just like our other games, but we struggled to make it fun. Maybe it was because neither of us had the mental capacity during those uncertain times. Eventually, we tried a different angle. We added a cast of colorful characters, including a smack-talking dolphin (don’t ask); that’s when we knew we’d hit the right note. 

So please enjoy this demo! Tell your friends, smack that wishlist button, etc. etc. — and thanks for your continued support. 🙏

Ben & Nancy

notes.title: Announcing our new game: Neo Harbor Rescue Squad!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=PMFicJOCIxU;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, everyone! We can at long last can announce our fourth original game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/]Neo Harbor Rescue Squad[/url]![/b]

This arcade-style action title fuses the mechanics of [b]popular medical-themed games[/b] from the Wii and DS era with fast-paced, challenging minigames so you get a taste of being a paramedic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27505172/fe695d3e3f19261a933eecaed0d138cb2d1b6bf5.gif[/img]

The Rescue Squad has long lived in the shadow of the Neo Harbor City's prestigious Fire Department, but no more! As the team's new paramedic rookie, players must respond to emergencies throughout the city, deal with difficult patients, and protect the squad's reputation against the machinations of news reporter Betty Woo!

[h2]Notable features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🩹 [b]Use our triage system[/b] to quickly monitor patients’ health, how much damage they’re taking, if they’re critical, and learn to prioritize treatment
[*] 🪟 [b]Quickly switch between different views[/b] to manage multiple patients across a variety of complex scenes
[*] 🛡️ [b]Use shields [/b]to temporarily protect your patients from damage, giving you some breathing room to strategize
[*] 🅰️ [b]Aim for a high rank[/b] with each emergency; be graded based on speed, skill, and the condition of your patients
[*] 💬 [b]Make dialogue choices[/b] to deal with the public, advance the story, and get to know your squadmates
[*] 🐬 Laugh through a story of [b]teamwork and friendship (and dolphins)[/b], inspired by real paramedic stories in Asia!
[*] 👀 Be a paramedic in [b]up to native 4K![/b]
[/list]

[b]Sounds exciting? Then [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/]wishlist the game today![/url] [/b]🙏 Your support means a lot to us and helps us reach more players!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/

Curious about how/why we decided to make a paramedic action game? We'll be posting behind-the-scenes updates about our development process up until launch.

Thank you!
Ben + Nancy (BancyCo)

notes.title: UPDATE - v1.02 brings early content updates!
notes.content:
Today's update brings one major revision and one small fix. We noticed after watching more people playing the game online, via streams, etc. that people wanted to get through the first part of the game — the intro and the first mission to the Comms Relay — a whole lot more quickly. And after getting more feedback, we agreed. And so...

[h1]What's New:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Shortened the intro where you meet the AI — text is clearer, snappier and there's less of it
[*][b]Redesigned the first Comms Relay mission.[/b] The mission has three floors instead of five; a few items got shuffled around and now it's much faster to complete, getting you to your first holo-sim chamber encounter more quickly
[/list]
(Don't worry — if you were playing the game and it saved while in the middle of the Comms Relay mission, you'll be right back at that mission. However, you'll notice things look a little different when you return.)

[h1]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*]fixed an issue where you might not be able to take screenshots. These now work correctly and the Steam Overlay pop-up shows up now
[/list]

Happy playing!
B.

notes.title: UPDATE - v1.01 adds new control options, more
notes.content:
Hi all!

We have an update today to address a few issues and make the game nicer for everyone.

[b]v1.01 (for PC and Mac) patch notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]should correct an issue where controller/keyboard UI prompts are displayed incorrectly, or sporadically
[*]adds a new [b]Force Input[/b] mode that allows you to manually select whether you're using a keyboard, Xinput gamepad or DualShock®4 — just in case anything gets weird
[*]game no longer rumbles controllers if you aren't actively using them (even if they're plugged in)
[*]controls auto-revert to default ("auto") if there are no gamepads detected (even if you've manually forced the input to "gamepad" mode)
[*]a few little tweaks here and there
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/aae8d0dc363832fab0f016ddf0c931a9bd092060.png[/img]
You can access the new options within the pause menu, as usual.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Alone With You, 15% off!
notes.content:
Alone With You is Now Available on Steam and is 15% off!*

Alone With You is a bittersweet sci-fi adventure game that goes right for the heart. Escape a doomed space colony with the help of your troubled AI companion and four attractive holograms in this unique blend of adventure & visual novel storytelling.

*Offer ends February 16 at 10AM Pacific Time

notes.title: What's New in Alone With You for Steam?
notes.content:
With only two days to go until launch, excitement for AWY is heating up! But if you know about the PlayStation 4 and PlayStation Vita versions of the game, you might be wondering: what's new here?

[h1]A new way to keep in touch[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/1cacc46de80d7b34359aac6238628a1fc3934113.png[/img]

As you play through each day in the game, we hope you're thinking about your new hologram companions an awful lot, even as you wonder about the state of the planet outside. 

To help you feel more connected, we've added a new room to your home base at Colony A — the mess hall. You'll see this area, um, [i]evolve[/i] as your time within the game increases. Most importantly, though: it lets you get status reports from the AI on how your escape ship is coming along. And, if you play your cards right, some new insights into the thoughts of your four hologram friends.

[h1]Made with love for PC & Mac[/h1]

When AWY launched on PlayStation platforms, we made sure it felt great and used that hardware as much as we could. And so here, on PC & Mac, we wanted to make sure AWY is comfortable and easy to work with:
[list]
[*]supports keyboards and gamepads simultaneously — hot swap or use whatever you have plugged in
[*]Full-screen and windowed modes (the game will remember your window size when you load it up, too) — perfect for easy, one-screen Twitch stream setups
[*]Music and SFX volume sliders — adjust what you need for accessibility or for streams
[/list]

[h1]New spit and polish[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/153f805657d176a2144ae89307bf5c957290394f.png[/img]

We've added a few new little cutscenes, graphical tweaks, and a brand new texture filter to the game that makes it look better than ever before. A dynamic font system keeps the text readable and sharp, even in smaller windows. Little edits here and there make this the sharpest, nicest-looking version of AWY yet.

[h1]Soundtrack DLC![/h1]

Like to buy your game music within Steam? [b]The complete original soundtrack for Alone With You will be purchasable at launch as DLC,[/b] and will also be available in a combo bundle with the main game! Trust us — you won't be able to stop listening to the soundtrack anyway.


And that's it for now! See you on February 9, when Alone With You launches here on Steam!

notes.title: Meet the four special characters of Alone With You
notes.content:
We're just over a week away from Alone With You's launch here on Steam! And since the game is all about connections to people (hologram or otherwise), I wanted to introduce you to the four people you'll be spending the most time with in the game.

My favourite part of Alone With You is hearing about players' experiences with the four holograms — and, specifically, who their favourite was. There's a bit of a trick to that — but I can't tell you about that just yet. :-)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/e638deaa7501ac988ef9e416bea46f5d35277b2b.png[/img]

As the colony's communications expert, she was highly intelligent, but socially withdrawn. Winnie found the collapse of the installation particularly difficult to deal with.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/20c8dd35fd2540b001da7c062ab0229c395fee4e.png[/img]

As the director of the terraforming facility, his engineering genius was unparalleled. But his hubris and leadership style left many unanswered questions after disaster struck.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/ab33405513fc9fc4ce916dd7b8f5fb0497c76829.png[/img]

She managed the facility's Agro-Domes, and was a lover of all growing things. She was more at home in her garden than in a manager's office, though, and had difficulty keeping her team focused.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/68aeaa797687ac6830772adc144b4b1383cb2e25.png[/img]

He was the installation's Resource Manager, and a gifted explorer. His ability to problem-solve and think creatively made him excellent at his job, but often put him at odds with his peers.


See you back here on February 9th for the launch! Please make sure to put the game on your wishlist, and spread the word!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/e638deaa7501ac988ef9e416bea46f5d35277b2b.png[/img]

As the colony's communications expert, she was highly intelligent, but socially withdrawn. Winnie found the collapse of the installation particularly difficult to deal with.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/20c8dd35fd2540b001da7c062ab0229c395fee4e.png[/img]

As the director of the terraforming facility, his engineering genius was unparalleled. But his hubris and leadership style left many unanswered questions after disaster struck.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/ab33405513fc9fc4ce916dd7b8f5fb0497c76829.png[/img]

She managed the facility's Agro-Domes, and was a lover of all growing things. She was more at home in her garden than in a manager's office, though, and had difficulty keeping her team focused.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/68aeaa797687ac6830772adc144b4b1383cb2e25.png[/img]

He was the installation's Resource Manager, and a gifted explorer. His ability to problem-solve and think creatively made him excellent at his job, but often put him at odds with his peers.


See you back here on February 9th for the launch! Please make sure to put the game on your wishlist, and spread the word!

notes.title: Top 5 things you didn't know about Alone With You (but now you do)
notes.content:
Alone With You is now just three weeks away, but we've been working on it for quite a while. We want to share some fun bits you might not have known about the game.

So without further ado...

[b]5) Alone With You is a "love letter to the Sega CD"[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/801e17f56451c8bb60bf55357d4c1627e5c0d656.jpg[/img]
We've said this before, but AWY was an attempt to make "the Sega CD game we wish existed." That's why it mixes 16-bit style, Genesis-era visuals with a rich, deep soundtrack that would have required the then-amazing new "compact disc" format. In fact, the entire game uses the Sega Genesis hardware colour palette — all 512 colours. (We did cheat from time to time.) Pay attention when you're playing — you might even notice a rather obvious tip of the hat to Sega's disc-spinning console in the game...

[b]4) Alone With You is meant to provoke real, honest feelings[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/713a4ed2f9c7e9546e3d165527bd75c6725baf27.jpg[/img]
The goal of the game was to see if players could feel real things towards very not-real people. There are some tough choices and, we hope, some great characterization and writing that helps with that. In our experience, players tend to admit that they have a favourite hologram [of the people you can visit in the game], which reveals something of their personality...

[b]3) Alone With You is very, very Canadian[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/f99b016427d4a664e314eceea63ddd5f59d60243.jpg[/img]
From the names and little references to the fact that we use a lot of "ou"s in words like "favourite," AWY is Canadian-made, and offers a lot of little nods to its country of origin. Canucks, be on the lookout! 

[b]2) Alone With You is more than five times bigger than [i]Home[/i][/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/4e3147bbe3cd519c53e6359566b32987c5264876.jpg[/img]
I loved making [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/215670/]Home[/url] because it was a tight, focused expression if a single idea. With AWY, I wanted to try something more ambitious (and that's why a team made it, and "I" am a "we" for this game). Most players spend about 4–6 hours in a single playthrough, but we've had players spend [i]much[/i] more than that to get achievements and see all there is to see. And since you get to choose which missions you embark on during the game, it feels a lot more personal.

[b]1) Alone With You is for everyone[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/bee8457788150339c05b30a1d98d9ddfe0ee5789.jpg[/img]
Usually in dating sims, the main character is a dude. Then my wife will say, "WTF? I want to play this @#$%ing game!" And you know what? She's totally right. So in Alone With You, your character is you — or whoever you want to be. You enter your name, and that's it — talk to anyone you want, feel anything you feel, without restrictions.

notes.title: So excited to bring Alone With You to Steam!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27505172/dd227e770217cf25a58c422ec88d7f79da9c40ce.jpg[/img]

Hey, everyone!

I jumped into the Steam community back in 2012 when I launched [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/215670/]Home[/url], and after releasing [i]Alone With You[/i] on PS4 and Vita, I'm pumped to bring this follow-up here to Steam fans.

Alone With You is a "sci-fi romance adventure" — and it's a bit like a [i]Star Trek[/i] episode crossed with a dating sim, but a whole lot more tragic. It's meaty (average 4–6 hours of gameplay, but it can be more!), and has lots to offer players who like exploring, learning about the world, and really getting to know some "remarkably well-written" characters ([url=http://www.gamespot.com/reviews/alone-with-you-review/1900-6416503/]Gamespot[/url] said that, not us).

Like [i]Home[/i], it's a narrative-focused game where your choices affect things, but this time around, the story itself is more detailed, more substantial, and will tug your heartstrings in all sorts of unexpected directions.

I hope you'll put the game on your wishlist, tell folks who may be interested, and of course, give it a try on February 9th! (The game features a 15% launch discount, so why not dive in?)

I'll speak to you again soon with more details!

– Ben (and the whole team)
